description: The copies of sluice's answers of a preview: its answer to a preview's ask, or a row of its listing, sluice preview <branch> <revision> --json or sluice previews --json, and its answer to a release, sluice release <name> --json, each cut to the fields the cloud keeps, each where sluice printed it and as sluice printed it. Neither holds a preview's checkout, names, ports, exit, output or release_failed.

preview.description: The copy of a preview, as sluice's ask or its listing printed it.

name.description: The name sluice gave the preview, which its release names.

state.description: The preview's state, as sluice printed it.

addresses.description: Each address of the preview's stack, by its name.

release.description: The copy of a release, as sluice's release printed it.

preview.description: The name of the preview released.

released.description: Whether sluice put a preview away.
